reference_sql:
WITH store_revenue AS (
  -- one row per physical store with a 2025 order
  SELECT s.store_code, s.city,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_type <> 'web'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.city
)
SELECT store_code, city, net_revenue_eur
FROM store_revenue
WHERE net_revenue_eur > (SELECT AVG(net_revenue_eur) FROM store_revenue)
ORDER BY store_code

SELECT t.store_code, t.city, t.net_revenue_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per physical store with a 2025 order
  SELECT st.store_code, st.city, SUM(sa.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM sales AS sa
  JOIN stores AS st ON st.store_code = sa.store_code
  WHERE st.store_type <> 'web'
    AND sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY st.store_code, st.city
) AS t
WHERE t.net_revenue_eur > (
  SELECT AVG(a.net_revenue_eur)
  FROM (
    -- one row per physical store with a 2025 order
    SELECT sa.store_code, SUM(sa.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
    FROM sales AS sa
    JOIN stores AS st ON st.store_code = sa.store_code
    WHERE st.store_type <> 'web'
      AND sa.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY sa.store_code
  ) AS a
)
ORDER BY t.store_code

WITH store_revenue AS (
  -- one row per physical store with a 2025 order
  SELECT s.store_code, s.city,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM stores AS s
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN order_lines AS ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE s.store_type IN ('flagship', 'standard', 'outlet')
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.city
),
average_store AS (
  -- one row: the average store's net revenue
  SELECT AVG(net_revenue_eur) AS avg_revenue_eur
  FROM store_revenue
)
SELECT sr.store_code, sr.city, sr.net_revenue_eur
FROM store_revenue AS sr
CROSS JOIN average_store AS a
WHERE sr.net_revenue_eur > a.avg_revenue_eur
ORDER BY sr.store_code

SELECT s.store_code, s.city,
       SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE s.store_type <> 'web'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.store_code, s.city
HAVING SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) > (
  SELECT SUM(ol2.quantity * ol2.unit_price_eur - ol2.line_discount_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT o2.store_id)
  FROM order_lines AS ol2
  JOIN orders AS o2 ON o2.order_id = ol2.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s2 ON s2.store_id = o2.store_id
  WHERE s2.store_type <> 'web'
    AND o2.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o2.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
ORDER BY s.store_code

other_way.tradeoff: Derived tables need no WITH, but the store totals step is then written twice, and the two copies can drift apart.

solver.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT s.store_code, s.city,
         SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE s.store_type <> 'web'
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY s.store_code, s.city
)
SELECT store_code, city, net_revenue_eur
FROM r
WHERE net_revenue_eur > (SELECT AVG(net_revenue_eur) FROM r)
ORDER BY store_code
